args.title: Bellwether Office: Retail returns logistics — combined summary
args.body:
- This week's Bellwether Office newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to a feature article and a subscriber-only companion piece.
- Main article: apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
- Companion piece (subscriber access): reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
